Which statement describes the impulse acting on an object?
A
Impulse is the change in kinetic energy of the object.
B
Impulse is the change in momentum of the object.
C
Impulse is the rate of change of force acting on the object.
D
Impulse is the rate of change of momentum of the object.

options.label: A
options.text: Impulse is the change in kinetic energy of the object.
